lines.say: The overhead press. Here's what it really works.
Your shoulders do most of the pushing, especially the front.
Your triceps lock the weight out at the top.
Your upper chest and upper back help steady it.
And standing up, your core works hard to keep you from leaning back.
One study found standing presses worked the shoulders more, but people lifted more when seated.
Squeeze your glutes, brace your stomach, and push the bar straight up past your face.
